name: customer-support
summary: Support agents read their ticket's customer's records in PostgreSQL and refund Stripe payments in test mode: reads are scoped to the named customers and to public and internal columns, an approver releases refunds above 50.00 USD, refunds above 100.00 USD are refused, and the agent's grant refunds at most 500.00 USD a week.
protects: every refund above 50.00 USD waits for an independent approver
no refund above 100.00 USD is made, approved or not
the agent's grant refunds at most 500.00 USD a week (its budget)
a refund never exceeds what is left to refund on the payment, read from Stripe within the last 60 seconds

the agent's grant reads support.tickets, shop.customers and shop.orders only for the customers named with --customer: other customers' rows are never returned (record scope); narrow it to one ticket's customer with a delegated child grant
the agent named with --agent (required) reads only public and internal columns (pii and secret values are redacted), at most 50 rows at a time, and does not aggregate
the agent's grant covers creating and reading refunds, reading payments, and reading those three tables only
excludes: ticket updates and replies to the customer: M14 has no write connector for the ticket system
refunds in currencies other than USD: the rules fail closed (CANNOT_AUTHORIZE) until you add rules for them
whether a refund is justified: the approver decides from the payment and the reason the agent gives
whether the refunded payment belongs to the ticket's customer: the approver checks it
refunds made outside PantherClaw (the Stripe dashboard, another integration, a person with the API key) are not seen or limited
Stripe live mode: pc.stripe refuses live keys
data scoping needs the Team edition
the thresholds are examples: change them in a new policy version before relying on them
grant: creating refunds on Stripe payments, reading refunds and payments, 500.00 USD of refunds a week; reading the support tables for the named customers, public and internal columns only

connections: a pc.stripe connection with a restricted test key in enforce mode, which also provides the fact stripe.payment.refundable
a pc.postgres connection in enforce mode whose manifest lists support.tickets, shop.customers and shop.orders with scope key customer and classes every column
